description: This file defines a CoursesProvider class for managing course data, including loading course summaries from an API or mock service, filtering, enrollment status, and related state management logic. It also defines the CourseSummary data model used within the provider.

classes.name: CourseSummary
classes.description: A lightweight data model representing a course summary with methods to parse from JSON.

classes.name: CoursesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class providing course list management, filtering, enrollment, and data loading logic for a Flutter app.

methods.name: CourseSummary.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a CourseSummary instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: CoursesProvider.load
methods.description: Loads courses from either a mock service or API, handling state updates and errors.

methods.name: CoursesProvider.setSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query filter and notifies listeners.

methods.name: CoursesProvider.setCategory
methods.description: Sets the active category filter and notifies listeners.

methods.name: CoursesProvider.findById
methods.description: Finds and returns a course by its ID if available.

methods.name: CoursesProvider.enroll
methods.description: Enrolls the user in a course, updating state and optionally calling the API.

methods.name: CoursesProvider.unlockForTesting
methods.description: Method for testing purposes to mark a course as enrolled without API calls.
